framework.name: ISO/IEC 27001:2022
framework.description: International standard for an Information Security Management System (ISMS). Certification requires the management system clauses (4 to 10) plus the applicable Annex A controls, justified in a Statement of Applicability.

requirements.title: Understanding the organisation and its context
requirements.guidance: List internal and external issues that affect your ability to achieve ISMS outcomes.

requirements.title: Needs of interested parties
requirements.guidance: Identify customers, regulators, staff and others, their security requirements, and which you will address.

requirements.title: ISMS scope
requirements.guidance: Document the scope: locations, teams, products, systems and interfaces covered by the ISMS.

requirements.title: Information security management system
requirements.guidance: Establish, implement, maintain and continually improve the ISMS and its processes.

requirements.title: Leadership and commitment
requirements.guidance: Top management shows commitment: approves policy and objectives, provides resources, and reviews performance.

requirements.title: Information security policy
requirements.guidance: Publish a top-level security policy that includes objectives and a commitment to meet requirements and improve.

requirements.title: Roles, responsibilities and authorities
requirements.guidance: Assign and communicate ISMS responsibilities, including who reports ISMS performance to management.

requirements.title: Actions to address risks and opportunities
requirements.guidance: Plan how the ISMS addresses risks and opportunities identified from context and interested parties.

requirements.title: Information security risk assessment
requirements.guidance: Define and apply a repeatable risk assessment method with risk owners and acceptance criteria.

requirements.title: Information security risk treatment
requirements.guidance: Choose treatment options, compare controls with Annex A, produce a Statement of Applicability and a treatment plan approved by risk owners.

controls.title: Risk treatment and Statement of Applicability

requirements.title: Information security objectives
requirements.guidance: Set measurable security objectives with owners, resources and deadlines.

requirements.title: Planning of changes
requirements.guidance: Make changes to the ISMS in a planned way.

requirements.title: Resources
requirements.guidance: Provide people, budget and tools needed for the ISMS.

requirements.title: Competence
requirements.guidance: Define required competence for ISMS roles and keep evidence of it.

requirements.title: Awareness
requirements.guidance: Staff know the policy, their contribution, and the consequences of not following requirements.

requirements.title: Communication
requirements.guidance: Decide what, when, with whom and how to communicate about security, internally and externally.

requirements.title: Documented information: general
requirements.guidance: Keep the documented information the standard and your ISMS need.

requirements.title: Creating and updating documents
requirements.guidance: Documents have identification, review and approval.

requirements.title: Control of documented information
requirements.guidance: Control distribution, access, storage, version and retention of documents.

requirements.title: Operational planning and control
requirements.guidance: Plan and control the processes that meet security requirements, including outsourced processes and changes.

requirements.title: Information security risk assessment (performed)
requirements.guidance: Run risk assessments at planned intervals and on significant change, and keep the results.

requirements.title: Information security risk treatment (performed)
requirements.guidance: Implement the risk treatment plan and keep the results.

controls.title: Risk treatment and Statement of Applicability

requirements.title: Monitoring, measurement, analysis and evaluation
requirements.guidance: Decide what to measure, how and when, and evaluate ISMS effectiveness.

controls.title: Security metrics and monitoring of the programme

requirements.title: Internal audit: general
requirements.guidance: Run internal audits at planned intervals to check the ISMS conforms and is effective.

requirements.title: Internal audit programme
requirements.guidance: Plan the audit programme with criteria, scope, impartial auditors and reporting to management.

requirements.title: Management review: general
requirements.guidance: Top management reviews the ISMS at planned intervals.

requirements.title: Management review inputs
requirements.guidance: Cover previous actions, changes, performance, feedback, risk results and improvement opportunities.

requirements.title: Management review results
requirements.guidance: Record decisions on improvements and changes to the ISMS.

requirements.title: Continual improvement
requirements.guidance: Continually improve the suitability, adequacy and effectiveness of the ISMS.

requirements.title: Nonconformity and corrective action
requirements.guidance: React to nonconformities, find root causes, take corrective action and keep records.

requirements.title: Policies for information security
requirements.guidance: Approved, published, communicated and reviewed security policies and topic-specific policies.

requirements.title: Information security roles and responsibilities
requirements.guidance: Define and allocate security roles.

requirements.title: Segregation of duties
requirements.guidance: Separate conflicting duties to reduce fraud and error.

requirements.title: Management responsibilities
requirements.guidance: Managers require staff and contractors to follow security policies.

requirements.title: Contact with authorities
requirements.guidance: Maintain contacts with regulators and authorities such as CERT-In and law enforcement.

controls.title: Contact with authorities, CERT-In point of contact

requirements.title: Contact with special interest groups
requirements.guidance: Maintain contacts with security forums and professional groups.

controls.title: Contact with authorities, CERT-In point of contact

requirements.title: Threat intelligence
requirements.guidance: Collect and analyse threat information relevant to your organisation.

requirements.title: Information security in project management
requirements.guidance: Integrate security into project management.

controls.title: Security in projects and change initiatives

requirements.title: Inventory of information and other associated assets
requirements.guidance: Maintain an inventory of information and assets with owners.

requirements.title: Acceptable use of information and other associated assets
requirements.guidance: Document rules for acceptable use.

requirements.title: Return of assets
requirements.guidance: Recover organisational assets when employment or contracts end.

requirements.title: Classification of information
requirements.guidance: Classify information by confidentiality, integrity, availability and legal needs.

requirements.title: Labelling of information
requirements.guidance: Label information according to its classification.

requirements.title: Information transfer
requirements.guidance: Have rules and agreements for transferring information internally and externally.

requirements.title: Access control
requirements.guidance: Define access control rules based on business and security requirements.

requirements.title: Identity management
requirements.guidance: Manage the full lifecycle of identities.

controls.title: Joiner, mover and leaver access process

requirements.title: Authentication information
requirements.guidance: Control allocation and management of passwords and other authentication information.

requirements.title: Access rights
requirements.guidance: Provision, review, modify and remove access rights according to policy.

controls.title: Joiner, mover and leaver access process

requirements.title: Information security in supplier relationships
requirements.guidance: Manage security risks from suppliers' products and services.

requirements.title: Addressing information security within supplier agreements
requirements.guidance: Agree security requirements with each supplier in contracts.

controls.title: Vendor contracts and data processing agreements

requirements.title: Managing information security in the ICT supply chain
requirements.guidance: Manage security risks in the ICT product and service supply chain.

controls.title: Vendor contracts and data processing agreements

requirements.title: Monitoring, review and change management of supplier services
requirements.guidance: Monitor and review supplier security and manage changes.

requirements.title: Information security for use of cloud services
requirements.guidance: Define how cloud services are acquired, used, managed and exited.

requirements.title: Incident management planning and preparation
requirements.guidance: Plan incident management with defined processes, roles and responsibilities.

requirements.title: Assessment and decision on information security events
requirements.guidance: Assess events and decide whether they are incidents.

requirements.title: Response to information security incidents
requirements.guidance: Respond to incidents according to documented procedures.

requirements.title: Learning from information security incidents
requirements.guidance: Use lessons from incidents to strengthen controls.

requirements.title: Collection of evidence
requirements.guidance: Identify, collect and preserve evidence related to security events.

requirements.title: Information security during disruption
requirements.guidance: Maintain security at an appropriate level during disruption.

requirements.title: ICT readiness for business continuity
requirements.guidance: Plan, implement, maintain and test ICT readiness for continuity objectives.

requirements.title: Legal, statutory, regulatory and contractual requirements
requirements.guidance: Identify and keep current your legal, regulatory and contractual security requirements.

requirements.title: Intellectual property rights
requirements.guidance: Protect intellectual property rights, including software licensing.

requirements.title: Protection of records
requirements.guidance: Protect records from loss, destruction, falsification and unauthorised access or release.

requirements.title: Privacy and protection of PII
requirements.guidance: Meet privacy and personal data protection requirements, including DPDP.

controls.title: Privacy by design and organisational measures

requirements.title: Independent review of information security
requirements.guidance: Have the security approach reviewed independently at planned intervals or on major change.

requirements.title: Compliance with policies, rules and standards
requirements.guidance: Regularly check compliance with security policies and standards.

requirements.title: Documented operating procedures
requirements.guidance: Document operating procedures and make them available to those who need them.

requirements.title: Screening
requirements.guidance: Run background verification checks proportionate to the role and the law.

requirements.title: Terms and conditions of employment
requirements.guidance: Employment contracts state security responsibilities.

requirements.title: Information security awareness, education and training
requirements.guidance: Provide regular, role-appropriate security training.

requirements.title: Disciplinary process
requirements.guidance: Have a communicated disciplinary process for policy violations.

requirements.title: Responsibilities after termination or change of employment
requirements.guidance: Security duties that remain after leaving are defined and communicated.

requirements.title: Confidentiality or non-disclosure agreements
requirements.guidance: Use NDAs that reflect your protection needs, reviewed regularly.

requirements.title: Remote working
requirements.guidance: Protect information accessed or processed when working remotely.

requirements.title: Information security event reporting
requirements.guidance: Give staff a clear way to report security events quickly.

requirements.title: Physical security perimeters
requirements.guidance: Define perimeters protecting areas with information and assets.

requirements.title: Physical entry
requirements.guidance: Protect secure areas with entry controls.

requirements.title: Securing offices, rooms and facilities
requirements.guidance: Design and implement physical security for offices and facilities.

requirements.title: Physical security monitoring
requirements.guidance: Monitor premises for unauthorised physical access.

requirements.title: Protecting against physical and environmental threats
requirements.guidance: Protect against fire, flood, power and other physical threats.

requirements.title: Working in secure areas
requirements.guidance: Define rules for working in secure areas.

requirements.title: Clear desk and clear screen
requirements.guidance: Enforce clear desk and clear screen rules.

requirements.title: Equipment siting and protection
requirements.guidance: Site and protect equipment securely.

requirements.title: Security of assets off-premises
requirements.guidance: Protect laptops and other assets used outside the office.

requirements.title: Storage media
requirements.guidance: Manage storage media through acquisition, use, transport and disposal.

requirements.title: Supporting utilities
requirements.guidance: Protect against power and other utility failures.

requirements.title: Cabling security
requirements.guidance: Protect power and data cabling from interception and damage.

requirements.title: Equipment maintenance
requirements.guidance: Maintain equipment correctly.

requirements.title: Secure disposal or re-use of equipment
requirements.guidance: Wipe or destroy data before disposing of or re-using equipment.

requirements.title: User endpoint devices
requirements.guidance: Protect information on laptops and mobile devices.

requirements.title: Privileged access rights
requirements.guidance: Restrict and manage privileged access.

requirements.title: Information access restriction
requirements.guidance: Restrict access to information according to the access control policy.

requirements.title: Access to source code
requirements.guidance: Manage read and write access to source code and development tools.

requirements.title: Secure authentication
requirements.guidance: Use secure authentication such as MFA based on access restrictions.

requirements.title: Capacity management
requirements.guidance: Monitor and adjust resources to meet capacity needs.

requirements.title: Protection against malware
requirements.guidance: Protect against malware, supported by user awareness.

requirements.title: Management of technical vulnerabilities
requirements.guidance: Find, evaluate and fix technical vulnerabilities in a timely way.

requirements.title: Configuration management
requirements.guidance: Define, implement and monitor secure configurations.

requirements.title: Information deletion
requirements.guidance: Delete information when no longer required.

requirements.title: Data masking
requirements.guidance: Mask data according to access policy and legal requirements.

requirements.title: Data leakage prevention
requirements.guidance: Apply measures to prevent data leakage.

requirements.title: Information backup
requirements.guidance: Back up information and test restores regularly.

requirements.title: Redundancy of information processing facilities
requirements.guidance: Build enough redundancy to meet availability requirements.

requirements.title: Logging
requirements.guidance: Produce, store, protect and analyse logs of activities and events.

controls.title: Centralised logging with retention in India

requirements.title: Monitoring activities
requirements.guidance: Monitor networks and systems for anomalous behaviour and act on it.

requirements.title: Clock synchronisation
requirements.guidance: Synchronise system clocks to approved time sources.

requirements.title: Use of privileged utility programs
requirements.guidance: Restrict and control utilities that can override system controls.

requirements.title: Installation of software on operational systems
requirements.guidance: Control software installation on production systems.

requirements.title: Networks security
requirements.guidance: Secure, manage and control networks and devices.

requirements.title: Security of network services
requirements.guidance: Define and monitor security of network services.

requirements.title: Segregation of networks
requirements.guidance: Segregate groups of services, users and systems on networks.

requirements.title: Web filtering
requirements.guidance: Manage access to external websites to reduce exposure to malicious content.

requirements.title: Use of cryptography
requirements.guidance: Define and apply rules for cryptography and key management.

controls.title: Encryption at rest and key management

requirements.title: Secure development life cycle
requirements.guidance: Establish rules for secure development of software and systems.

requirements.title: Application security requirements
requirements.guidance: Identify and approve security requirements when building or buying applications.

requirements.title: Secure system architecture and engineering principles
requirements.guidance: Document and apply secure engineering principles.

requirements.title: Secure coding
requirements.guidance: Apply secure coding principles.

requirements.title: Security testing in development and acceptance
requirements.guidance: Define and run security testing in the development lifecycle.

requirements.title: Outsourced development
requirements.guidance: Direct, monitor and review outsourced development.

requirements.title: Separation of development, test and production environments
requirements.guidance: Separate and secure development, test and production environments.

requirements.title: Change management
requirements.guidance: Control changes to systems and facilities through change management.

requirements.title: Test information
requirements.guidance: Select, protect and manage test data appropriately.

requirements.title: Protection of information systems during audit testing
requirements.guidance: Plan audit tests on operational systems to minimise disruption.
